function.name: Grep
function.description: Recursively search file contents under a directory, or search a single file. Respects .gitignore. Returns matching lines with file path, line number, column number, and trimmed content. By default, `pattern` is interpreted as a regular expression. Set `literal` to true when searching for an exact string that may contain regex metacharacters. Examples: 1) Search exact 'TODO': {'pattern':'TODO','literal':true} 2) Search errors case-insensitively: {'pattern':'error|fail','ignoreCase':true} 3) Search only TypeScript files: {'pattern':'fetch','glob':'*.ts'}

pattern.description: Search pattern. Interpreted as regex by default. Set `literal` to true to match this string literally.

path.description: File or directory to search. Defaults to current directory. If a directory is given, it is searched recursively.

glob.description: Optional file filter (gitignore-style glob). Patterns without '/' match file names at any depth, e.g. '*.ts' or '**/*.spec.ts'. Patterns containing '/' are matched against paths relative to the working directory, not relative to `path`, e.g. 'src/**/*.ts'. If omitted, all text files are searched.

ignoreCase.description: If true, perform case-insensitive matching. Default false.

literal.description: If true, treat `pattern` as a literal string instead of a regular expression. Set this when the search text contains characters like . * ( ) [ ] \ ? + ^ $.

context.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match. Default 0.

limit.description: Maximum number of matching lines to return. Default 100.
